Fgpt_package.line_length module¶

class Fgpt_package.line_length.FortLineLength(line_length=132)[source]¶

Bases: object

This class processes a free-format Fortran code string, ensuring that any lines longer than the specified maximum line length are wrapped appropriately, using continuation characters based on the line type (e.g., statement, OpenMP, OpenACC, comment).

_line_length¶

The maximum allowed line length for Fortran code.

find_break_point(line, max_index, key_list)[source]¶

Finds the most appropriate break point for a Fortran line based on a list of keywords.

Parameters:

  • line (str) – The Fortran code line.

  • max_index (int) – The maximum index up to which the break point should be found.

  • key_list (list) – List of keywords that can serve as break points.

Returns:

The index where the break point occurs.

Return type:

int

Raises:

Exception – If no suitable break point is found within the allowed range.
